messages:
Aisha Patel: hi everyone :wave: setting up my new MBP M2 — when the Kandji enrollment runs it hangs on 'Preparing device' but only when the laptop is plugged into our wired ethernet. If I switch to wifi enrollment proceeds. Any idea?

Ravi (IT): welcome Aisha! do you see any error text or a modal? a screenshot or the last few lines of the installer log would help. also what macOS version?

Aisha Patel: macOS 13.6.1 (came preinstalled). The modal just says 'Preparing device...' forever. Posting short console dump I copied right before it stalls:

```
[MDM] enrollment: starting profile download
[Network] interface: en0 (Ethernet) link up
[MDM] download stalled - waiting on network config
socket_connect: errno=61
```

Ravi (IT): thanks. odd that it's the ethernet path. two quick questions: is the office network using a proxy or 802.1x auth? and can you try disabling ethernet and re-running via wifi to confirm it completes?

Aisha Patel: the switches are 802.1x but the laptop should be on a 'guest' VLAN during setup. i tried wifi and it finished fine. problem only reproducible when plugged in.

Kandji-bot: Device assignment notice: "Aisha Patel - MacBookPro14,3" assigned to kandji enrollment policy 'New Hire – Mac'. Enrollment attempt recorded at 2026-07-19T15:02:15Z.

Jordan (Device Admin): sounds like the switch is intercepting traffic until the device authenticates; Kandji needs to reach our enrollment endpoints (kandji.redwood-infra.example) over HTTPS during initial profile install. If the wired VLAN blocks that until 802.1x auth completes, the installer will hang. Two options:
1) Temporary workaround — unplug ethernet, finish enrollment over wifi, then replug ethernet.
2) Permanent fix — I can create a DHCP exception rule for the new device MAC to put it on onboarding VLAN that allows access to kandji endpoints before 802.1x. If you want me to do that reply with your MAC address (or I can remote-check once you approve).

Sam: another quick check — sometimes macOS prefers the wired interface and won't fall back to wifi. If you finish on wifi, open System Settings -> Network -> set Wi-Fi service above Ethernet in the interface order before replugging.

Aisha Patel: ok i tried unplugging ethernet and finishing on wifi — enrollment completed and FileVault prompt appeared. I set Wi-Fi higher in service order as Sam suggested. Replugged ethernet and it stayed enrolled. thanks!

Ravi (IT): great. Jordan — can you still add a short note to onboarding docs about the 802.1x switch caveat and the MAC exception option? we'll also add a line to the new-hires checklist: "If enrollment stalls on ethernet, finish on wifi + reorder interfaces, then replug."

Jordan (Device Admin): will do, adding a KB snippet now and opening a ticket to request the onboarding VLAN rule with networking.

Helpdesk Bot: Ticket #INC-2026-779 opened (Jordan) — Networking: consider DHCP onboarding exception for new Mac devices.

Aisha Patel: awesome, thanks everyone! much appreciated :tada:
